sample.question:
The synchronized front, right, and top panels show labeled beacons in a 5x5x5 coordinate cube. Coordinates are (x,y,z), each from 0 to 4. Rotation Z+ maps (x,y,z) to (4-y,x,z); rotation X+ maps it to (x,4-z,y).
Apply rotations X+, X+ in order. Where does beacon A finish?
A. (3, 2, 2)
B. (2, 3, 2)
C. (4, 2, 2)
D. (3, 3, 2)
sample.analysis: Start beacon A at (3, 2, 2). Applying ['X+', 'X+'] successively gives (3, 2, 2). The answer is A.
